authorization: User selected all local Codex and Claude tasks for metadata-only recording.

recording.stored: host/session identity, opaque auto task ID, receipt times, allowlisted event metadata and payload hash
recording.excluded: prompts, document contents, tool arguments/results, transcript contents and automatic cwd storage
recording.unknown: complete usage, billed cost, human active time, prompt authorship and correction totals

installation.native_codex_trust: nine exact definitions reviewed through native CLI; native hooks/list confirms trusted

integrated_regressions.scope: integrated core observer, host adapter and installer

qualification.amendment: Unknown wrapper metadata was removed from the nominal shared-wrapper fixture and added to refusal cases. Original candidate retained; failures preserved.
qualification.native_claude: Known session ID captured SessionStart and SessionEnd; no task prompt. First additional Claude diagnostic has unattributed session identity in its launch receipt.
qualification.native_codex: Known review session and fresh post-trust session each captured SessionEnd only; no SessionStart or working-turn lifecycle established.
qualification.version_note: Claude native updater changed version between diagnostics; no explicit update command issued.
qualification.ongoing_desktop_tasks: not_yet_native_qualified; host must load updated configuration and deliver supported events

limitations: Receipt of supported events is partial coverage, not a census of all tasks or tools.
Enrollment commits before core event insertion; later failure can leave an enrolled session with no events.
Installation checks all targets before writing, then replaces files separately; it is not a multi-file crash-atomic transaction.
Older running sessions may retain previously loaded hooks; no reload of unrelated active work was forced.

investor_questions.exact_claim: An explicit all-local policy enrolls a valid first observed event while preserving existing records and metadata exclusions.
investor_questions.comparator: Existing manual enrollment behavior, retained as the generic adapter default; no competing agent trial.
investor_questions.stop_criterion: Do not claim installed equals complete capture. Stop after bounded implementation, independent checks and prompt-free native receipts; leave missing working-turn evidence explicit.
investor_questions.losses: Original installer fixture blocked two groups; evaluator amendment retained. Codex probes did not capture SessionStart. First Claude launch lacked a predetermined identity and required one additional identified probe. Ongoing desktop turn coverage remains unqualified.
investor_questions.real_cost: Four prompt-free native diagnostics, implementation, review and setup. No benchmark worker run; complete resource and human cost remain unknown.
investor_questions.next_expenditure_decision: Reconcile the next ordinary local tasks against actual enrolled IDs and request/tool/stop events before funding a comparison. Use external evidence for human corrections; prompt counts are not corrections.

public_payload: Code, generic probes, aggregate facts and hashes; raw settings, IDs, databases and native UI receipts remain private.

historical_evidence.reason: Initial program validation flagged four evolved source paths; old artifact bytes and identities are now preserved separately.
